title: Pooveli
desc: When a man helps his classmate after the death of her lover, her family mistakes him for her husband. But the girl tries to make her family hate him so that he can go on with his life.

title: Kannodu Kanbathellam
desc: Seetharam is in love with Kalyani and wants to propose to her. However, when two lovers, Akhila and Akash, play a prank on Seetharam that results in him losing Kalyani, he takes revenge on them.

title: Maha Nadigan
desc: Sathya, a junior artiste, manages to secure a chance to play a hero in a movie. As his fame gradually increases, he decides to enter politics.

title: Hero
desc: Sakthi dreams of becoming a superhero. His wish unexpectedly comes true when the girl he is helping secure college admission dies due to unforeseen circumstances.
